mapper.select: select id, level, top_id as topId, parent_id as parentId, title, content, progress, status, dead_line as deadLine, sort_order as sortOrder, user_id as userId from mes_rec_goal where deleted_flag = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and status not in ('completed', 'cancel', 'paused') and ( dead_line is null or dead_line >= #{todayStart} or dead_line < #{todayStart} ) order by sort_order asc, id asc
